en: Udāna 3.5 Mahāmoggallānasutta Thus have I heard:
On one occasion the Blessed One was dwelling at Sāvatthī in Jeta’s Grove, Anāthapiṇḍika’s monastery.

Now on that occasion the Venerable Mahāmoggallāna was sitting not far from the Blessed One, having folded his legs crosswise, set his body erect, and established mindfulness directed to the body within with a mind well-established.

The Blessed One saw the Venerable Mahāmoggallāna sitting not far away, having folded his legs crosswise, set his body erect, and established mindfulness directed to the body within with a mind well-established.
Then the Blessed One, having understood this matter, on that occasion uttered this inspired exclamation:
restrained regarding the six bases of contact;”
“A bhikkhu who is constantly concentrated Will know Nibbāna for himself.
